summary: PASS within the bounded first saved-pixel scope. Both English views show a coherent text column with normal paragraph and section separation. Opening text is legible in the unscaled viewport captures. Figure 67 has clear English object labels at the recorded desktop 640/mobile 358 media widths, without visible clipping or label/drawing collisions. The caption is visibly placed below the figure in each whole-page preview. No blocking visible finding was observed.

basis: The desktop opening capture shows a legible title, crumb, rounded-drop introduction and surface-tension definition, with clear line and paragraph spacing.
The mobile opening capture keeps the title, two-line crumb and body text inside side margins; long prose wraps rather than running off the screen.
The visible definition and its qualification remain grouped and readable. The passed textual explanation was not re-reviewed as a science/source gate.
Whole-page previews show continued paragraph separation through the course, but their downscaling limits fine-glyph conclusions.
Whole-page previews retain a continuous reading sequence from the opening through the faucet and subsequent sections to the final density paragraph.
Section separators have visible spacing and do not cover adjacent prose.
The faucet passage precedes the inline figure; the Figure 67 caption follows it before the next section.
Paragraphs remain visually distinct on both the wide and narrow layouts. No visible text/figure ordering or gross overlap defect appears.
visibleFlow.fineGlyphScope: Bounded preview-level layout/flow only, not an exhaustive native-size transcription.

basis: No horizontal clipping is visible in the unscaled opening captures.
Title, crumb, body paragraphs, separators and figure have distinct spaces in the whole-page previews.
Both saved figure captures contain complete visible labels and drawing extents, with white clearance between text and drawing.
Bottom-edge truncation of an ongoing line in a viewport capture is normal capture framing, not evidence that the scrollable page has lost text.
Both whole-page previews visibly place Figure 67 below the faucet/drop image, separate from the next section.
The saved figure captures show the three English labels Faucet, Attached drop and Detached drop, legible and collision-free.
No Chinese visible title, caption or object label was observed in the assigned screenshots.
The figure-only captures do not include the caption; caption placement evidence is specifically the whole-page previews, not an invented seventh crop.

limitations.boundedTallPreview: The two whole-page screenshots were inspected once as automatically downscaled previews; no extra crops, zoom captures or reopens were allowed or performed.
limitations.fineGlyph: Visible opening prose and the three figure labels were inspected in the unscaled saved detail captures. This does not certify every glyph of every paragraph, tiny caption or embedded raster at native size.
limitations.ChineseAria: The supplied native/display reports explicitly retain Chinese machine/ARIA labels. Screenshots do not establish screen-reader correctness or complete English accessibility; that approval remains false.
limitations.headless: Evidence is isolated offline headless native-course HTML. It is not production browser acceptance, headed acceptance, interaction testing or a live product-session review.
limitations.sourceAndScience: Passed textual/source/science conclusions were retained without replay. No original/source image or original figure-review evidence was reopened.
limitations.generationEvidence: No new rendering/generation was performed. This report does not certify original PNG/generation evidence or embedded raster glyphs as unchanged.
